tools.name: search_parts
tools.title: Search car parts
tools.description: Search JOY Automart's automotive parts catalogue in Bangladesh. Accepts English, Bangla (e.g. 'টয়োটা এক্সিও ব্রেক প্যাড') or Banglish. Returns retail prices in BDT, availability and a product URL. Catalogue-only RFQ templates are omitted unless include_rfq_catalogue is true. Results are fitment candidates, not guarantees.

query.description: Part name, OEM number or vehicle, in English or Bangla.

chassis.description: Chassis code, e.g. NZE141 or G05.

include_rfq_catalogue.description: Include catalogue-only templates available through a parts request (RFQ).

tools.name: get_part
tools.title: Get part details
tools.description: Full public detail for one catalogue part: BDT price, stock, minimum order, verified offers and bulk price breaks.

tools.name: search_vehicles
tools.title: Search cars for sale
tools.description: Search JOY Auto Exchange vehicle listings in Bangladesh by make, model, year, fuel and BDT price. Only stated listing facts are returned.

include_unpriced.description: Include vehicles with a pending or undisclosed asking price (POA).

tools.name: get_vehicle
tools.title: Get car details
tools.description: Full public detail for one JOY Auto Exchange listing (by listing id or slug): BDT price, specs, photos and, when the car passed JOY's human QC, a summary of the inspection. Only stated listing facts are returned; seller contact details and reserves are never exposed.

tools.name: get_auction_status
tools.title: Auction status
tools.description: Public status of one live or recent JOY auction: current bid in BDT, bid count, end time and anti-snipe extensions. Observation only: bidding needs a verified dealer account and a human. The seller's reserve and bidder identities are never shown. Returns an error while live auctions are not open.

tools.name: compare_vehicles
tools.title: Compare cars
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2 to 4 listings (ids or slugs from search_vehicles): price, year, mileage, fuel, verification and inspection grade. Listings that cannot be found are reported, not hidden.

tools.name: get_buying_guide
tools.title: Bangladesh buying terms
tools.description: How to buy from JOY Automart: currency (BDT), payment methods (card, bKash/Nagad/Rocket, cash on delivery), Dhaka and nationwide delivery zones and fees, human contact, and how an authenticated agent can place orders.

tools.name: prepare_buyer_handoff
tools.title: Prepare purchase handoff
tools.description: Compose the links a human buyer uses to complete a purchase: the product page and a pre-filled WhatsApp message with canonical part details and fitment limitations. JOY confirms pricing and purchase eligibility. Creates nothing and charges nothing.

vehicle.description: Make, model, year or VIN, to speed up fitment checks.
